plan.rationale: With AIR 1's pass complete, I am dispatching two drones to our highest-risk unassessed and trapped-occupant sites while holding D3 in reserve. D1 will survey the unscanned FiDi URM-infill block at One Sansome Street (~9,019 occupants, up to 65% collapse risk), and D2 will verify four nearby Financial District and Jackson Square buildings where trapped signs and collapses were spotted. D3 remains at Embarcadero Plaza for follow-up sorties or emerging fire and collapse reports.
